\[
u=x^2+1 \quad\Rightarrow\quad du=2x\,dx \quad\Rightarrow\quad x\,dx=\frac{du}{2}.
\]

Then
\[
\int x(x^2+1)^{1/2}\,dx
= \int u^{1/2}\cdot \frac{du}{2}
= \frac12 \int u^{1/2}\,du.
\]

Now integrate:
\[
\frac12 \cdot \frac{u^{3/2}}{3/2}+C
= \frac12\cdot \frac{2}{3}u^{3/2}+C
= \frac13 u^{3/2}+C.
\]

Substitute back \(u=x^2+1\):
\[
\boxed{\int x(x^2+1)^{1/2}\,dx=\frac13(x^2+1)^{3/2}+C}
\]
